name: 9 Hunters
description: The classic glass-cannon hunter board: six cheap hunters three-starred early, then Tidehunter as the ninth hunter for the knockback + extra-attack payoff. Telescope grants the Dwarf range/damage bonus. Sourced from the YouTube guide 'HOW TO PLAY 9 Hunters Build In Auto Chess | 3 Variations'.

snapshots.label: Final board
snapshots.focusNote: 9 Hunters = 100% precise shots, -10 armour, and a knockback that adds an extra attack. Telescope on Windranger makes 2 Dwarves with Sniper for +200 range and distance-scaling damage. Spread wide for max range vs mages/early game; ball up in a corner vs assassins so they can't leap the backline.
